neighbours.label: An amount of time stating how long it takes to get to or from a named place (minutes or hours from/to somewhere, by car, by train, on foot) or how long a text takes to read (reading time, "min read"), with the peak on the time word or the word right after it; quiet for durations that are not a trip or a read (waiting, cooking, drying, meetings, film running times) and for travel words with no duration.
neighbours.short: travel time to a place, or reading time

Lyon is about two hours from Paris on the high-speed train.
The beach is a ten-minute walk from our hotel.
It takes roughly forty minutes to drive to the airport from downtown.
From the village, the summit hut is three hours on foot.
Our new office is just 15 minutes from Brooklyn by subway.
